meta.name: apollo-enterprise-rbac
meta.description:
Enterprise role-based access control for Apollo.io.
Use when implementing team permissions, restricting data access,
or setting up enterprise security controls.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo rbac", "apollo permissions",
"apollo roles", "apollo team access", "apollo enterprise security".

copy.tagline: 按角色配置团队权限,控制 Apollo 数据可见范围
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在 Apollo 中需要按角色限制团队成员的可见数据
copy.tagline_en: Set role-based team permissions and control data access in Apollo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Apollo team access and need role-based data visibility

howto.what: 装好后,Claude会为Apollo.io配置角色权限:按角色限制数据访问、实现团队隔离,并产出API密钥范围、权限中间件和管理后台接口。
howto.when: 当提到“apollo rbac”“apollo permissions”等关键词,或要求实施团队权限、限制数据访问、设置企业安全控制时触发。

say.text: 给Apollo配置角色权限:销售组只能看自己的客户
say.note: Claude会据此配置团队隔离和权限规则。

say.text: 限制API密钥只能访问联系人数据
为Apollo添加管理员后台和审计日志
say.note: Claude会输出相应端点与记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will configure role-based access control for Apollo.io: restrict data access by role, enable team isolation, and produce API key scoping, permission middleware, and admin dashboard endpoints.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'apollo rbac' or 'apollo permissions', or ask to implement team permissions, restrict data access, or set up enterprise security controls.

say_en.text: Set up Apollo RBAC: sales team can only see their own customer accounts.
say_en.note: Claude will implement team isolation and permission rules.

say_en.text: Restrict API keys to only access contact data.
say_en.note: Claude will scope the keys accordingly.

say_en.text: Add an admin dashboard and audit logs for Apollo.
say_en.note: Claude will output the related endpoints and records.
